claims.snippet:
436. RUMINOCOCCUS ALBUS MEDIUM


 Tryptone                                                                       5.0         g
 Yeast extract                                                                  2.0         g
 Glucose                                                                        3.0         g
 Cellobiose                                                                     2.0         g
 Mineral solution 1                                                           40.0        ml
 Mineral solution 2                                                           40.0        ml
 Resazurin                                                                      1.0       mg
 Distilled water                                                             920.0        ml

Boil and cool under CO2. Under a gentle stream of CO2 add:
 Na2CO3                                                                         4.0         g
 Fatty acid mixture                                                             1.0       ml
 Cysteine-HCl x H2O                                                          500.0        mg

Adjust pH to 7.0, distribute under N2 into appropriate vessels and sterilize.

Mineral solution 1:
 K2HPO4                                                                         0.6        %

Mineral solution 2:
 KH2PO4                                                                         0.6        %
 (NH4)2SO4                                                                      2.0        %
 NaCl                                                                           1.2        %
 MgSO4 x 7 H2O                                                                0.25         %
 CaCl2 x 7 H2O                                                                0.16         %

Fatty acid mixture:
 Isobutyric acid                                                              10.0        ml
 Isovaleric acid                                                              10.0        ml
 2-Methylbutyric acid                                                         10.0        ml
 Distilled water                                                              70.0        ml

Inoculate under CO2 and incubate at 37C.
